$comment: Shared settings. Each person's own values (operator, prefix, test user, requests) go in config/local.json (git-ignored), written during onboarding. Agents use project.json deep-merged with local.json. Never put passwords here.

operator.$comment: Filled per person in config/local.json during onboarding.

testUser.$comment: SAP user IDs are max 12 chars: approved exception to the Z_VOT_BEMIND prefix. flpRole = existing FLP runtime role, assigned together with the derived role.

naming.$comment: <PREFIX> is replaced by naming.prefix (personal value in config/local.json). abapClass is the shared helper class of the reference run.

transport.$comment: Requests used for MDM_HQ (both OTEL, open). Ask the user before reusing them for another profile or another person.

authOverrides.$comment: Applied automatically by the Role Builder after authorization generation (user decision 2026-10-21). ACTVT comes from the matrix access type of the profile's BP entry. Reason: SU24 proposes F4 only for these objects -> BP display of customers/suppliers fails (MDM_HQ test T01).
